kind.description: Whether a path is a single file or a directory tree.

mode.description: pull_only: this machine only receives changes. push_only: it only publishes them. bidirectional: both.

branch.description: The Git branch to sync. Default: the repository's branch.

repository_id.description: The registered config sync repository to use: its id or name (pb config repository list).

url.description: The repository's Git URL. Normally left out: the registered repository's own URL is used.

ruleConfig.description: How one path syncs. Leave a key out to inherit it from the os section or the shared file.

exclude.description: Files matching one of these patterns never sync. Same pattern rules as include.

include.description: For a directory: only files matching one of these patterns sync (** matches across directories). Patterns are relative, use /, and contain no ..

local_path.description: Where the path lives on this machine: absolute, or starting with ~ or %APPDATA%. Destinations are never inferred.

section.description: One os or machine section: the keys of the file except os and machine.

$schema.description: The JSON Schema of this file, so editors check and complete it. Ignored by Paperboat.

automatic_updates.description: Whether changes found in the repository are applied without asking.

enabled.description: Whether config sync runs on this machine.

mode.description: Which way files move: pull_only, push_only or bidirectional.

paths.description: The files and directories that sync, keyed by their path inside the repository, like editor/settings.json: a relative path with / separators, no .. and no Windows reserved names. Two paths may not contain one another.

pull.description: The repository this machine pulls from.

push.description: The repository this machine pushes to. Default: the pull repository.

version.description: The file format version. Only 1 exists.

description: Which files and directories config sync keeps in a Git repository, where they live on each machine, and which way they move. It is the shared file .paperboat/config-sync.jsonc in the repository, or one machine's own config-sync.jsonc (pb config sync path); the machine's file wins over the shared one. It may hold // comments and trailing commas (HuJSON); an empty file is valid.

$schema.description: The JSON Schema of this file, so editors check and complete it. Ignored by Paperboat.

automatic_updates.description: Whether changes found in the repository are applied without asking.

enabled.description: Whether config sync runs on this machine.

machine.description: Settings for one machine, keyed by its Paperboat name. They override the os section. Only in the shared file in the repository, never in a machine's own file. A section holds the same keys, except os and machine.

mode.description: Which way files move: pull_only, push_only or bidirectional.

os.description: Settings for one operating system, keyed linux, darwin or windows. They override the file's top-level settings on that system. A section holds the same keys, except os and machine.

paths.description: The files and directories that sync, keyed by their path inside the repository, like editor/settings.json: a relative path with / separators, no .. and no Windows reserved names. Two paths may not contain one another.

pull.description: The repository this machine pulls from.

push.description: The repository this machine pushes to. Default: the pull repository.

version.description: The file format version. Only 1 exists.

title: Paperboat config sync file
